Een verzoek om informatie van de gemeent: A request to make information held by the municipality public, under the Open Government Act (Woo).
Iedereen mag een Woo-verzoek indienen, z: Anyone may submit a Woo request, without giving a reason. The municipality decides within four weeks and can extend that once by two weeks. The documents made public are in the catalogue Woo requests.
